{{Item infobox | type = crafting material, gizmo | description = Take this stone to the [[Mystic Forge]] to have [[Zommoros]] forge something special for you. | rarity = rare | material type = mystic | bound = account | id = 19983 }} == Acquisition == === Sold by === {{Sold by}} === Contained in === {{contained in}} == Used in == {{recipe list}} === Item substitution === A stone can be used in place of one piece of [[equipment]] for the forge's conversion recipes. * Three items must be equipment of equal rarity, i.e. any combination of three [[armor]], [[trinket]]s, or [[weapon]]. * The chance to upgrade is the same as with normal like-item rarity conversion: 20%. * The stone takes the place of a fourth item of equal rarity, with level equivalent to the average level of the first three items. The replaced item will be either a generic armor, trinket or weapon, depending on the other 3 items used, but will not have a specific subtype (e.g. it will be "a weapon", not "an axe"). All 3 items and the stone will be lost so do not put in items you want to keep. For example: ** Three Level 75 exotic axes + 1 stone = same as four random Level 75 exotic weapons; result will be a Level 75 or higher random exotic weapon. ** Two Level 75 rare axes + one Level 75 rare greatsword + 1 stone = same as four Level 75 rare weapons; result will be a Level 75 or higher weapon of either rare (80%) or exotic (20%) quality. * Placing three items into the forge will sometimes leave the stone unselectable as the fourth item. Reverse the order, placing the stone in first, and the other items will be allowed. == Currency for == {{Vendor query table|currency=Mystic Forge Stone}} == Notes == * Double clicking a stone will display "Tapping the Mystic Forge stone does not appear to do anything." * From [[Wizard's Vault Daily Objectives|Daily achievements]] alone, which give 10 Achievement Points (AP) per completion, an average of 1 Stone is obtained for every 5 completed Daily Completionist achievement. This is because [[Achievement Chest|Achievement Chests]] give a total of 100 Stones per 5000 AP across the four chest categories. Note that due to the daily AP cap of 15.000, this is limited to 300 Stones. === Value === * Comparing a {{item icon|Mystic Salvage Kit}}'s 250 charges to a {{item icon|Master's Salvage Kit}}'s 25 charges, one stone is worth {{coin|{{#expr:(10 * 1536 - (1536 + 800 + 288)) / 3 round0}}}}. * When used for item substitution, their best replacement is a generic {{rarity|Exotic}} weapon at a value of {{silver|20-30}}. As this will remove the guarantee of returning the specific weapon type, it cannot be used to target [[exotic greatsword]]s. * Depending on how many alternative methods are used each week, {{item icon|Provisioner Token}}s have a value of {{silver|~30}}. See [[Faction Provisioner]] for an overview of crafting prices. * If bought from the gem store, each stone has a cost of {{gem|45-50}} depending on the quantity bought.
